title: Market Entry Dossier: Flowbase in Indonesia
tagline: An institutional market intelligence deliverable system built across Google Sheets, Docs, and Slides—proving market viability, competitive white space, and localized go-to-market strategy.
problem: Generic research reports often rely on superficial AI generalities, lack dynamic quantitative modeling, and use disconnected PDFs that cannot integrate into a client's everyday Google Workspace operations.
solution: A synchronized three-part deliverable ecosystem: an institutional Sheets calculation engine (TAM/SAM/SOM, scoring formulas, source tracker), an in-depth Docs narrative report, and an 8-slide executive decision deck with native linked charts.
results: Single source of truth architecture where Docs tables and Slides charts update directly from Sheets formulas with zero manual retyping
Zero untraceable claims with 100% of quantitative metrics cross-referenced in an integrated Source Tracker
Strict Editorial Newspaper × 90s Terminal visual discipline executed with Paper (#F4F0E8) and Ink (#171717) tokens
Fully articulated market entry playbook for Flowbase capturing the $16.5M boutique creative agency beachhead in Indonesia
